command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== verify staged reads against their pinned sha256 (same bytes SPAdes assembles) =="
{ printf '%s  %s\n' 4f43bf362b2391f03b2621226a04fb702b025d39b0a002ff2adf6d885dda4b86 reads_1.fq.gz
  printf '%s  %s\n' 93f4a67742e5509e8eabfc1966c384f5e3e7faadca866d7c20a8db817a48eca0 reads_2.fq.gz
} > pins.sha256
sha256sum -c pins.sha256

echo "== MEGAHIT, -t 4 --min-count 2 (deterministic: verified identical across runs) =="
# megahit refuses a pre-existing -o dir; /tmp/out is fresh on the instance.
megahit -1 reads_1.fq.gz -2 reads_2.fq.gz -t 4 --min-count 2 -o out
cp out/final.contigs.fa contigs.fa

# ---- smoke check ----
N=$(grep -c '^>' contigs.fa)
BP=$(awk '!/^>/{t+=length($0)}END{print t}' contigs.fa)
{
  echo "megahit_contigs   $N   want exactly 2       (deterministic assembly, -t 4)"
  echo "megahit_total_bp  $BP   want exactly 400811"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
test "$N"  -eq 2
test "$BP" -eq 400811
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
